rules.text: Resolve conflicts in UR, FRS, DBD, Contract, Plan, API, UI order; stop on unresolved conflict.
Migrations are forward-only; never rewrite an applied migration or reset the development schema.
Keep implementation within the declared Task scope and do not change unrelated application layers.
Select validation gates from changed impact layer; unexpected paths escalate instead of being skipped.
Keep BIGINT technical keys and use decimal-safe arithmetic for authoritative money, quantity, conversion, and allocation.
Repository persistence is primitive; services own invariants and multi-table mutations are atomic.
Organization create evaluates at the persisted parent; hierarchy changes preserve canonical parent/context invariants.
The approved GROUP root is GROUP_DINKTECH; conflicting existing GROUP roots block bootstrap.
Per-lane PBAC precedence is ABSOLUTE_DENY, ALLOW, DENY, NO_MATCH; after base permission NO_MATCH allows.

Resolve Resource catalog/domain before authorization context: SYSTEM and MASTER evaluate at GROUP; ORGANIZATION uses its registered authoritative target/owner/parent/persisted-context resolver. Client context cannot override it, Primary Assignment is never a generic Resource-scope fallback, and missing/unknown/unresolved context fails closed.

rules.text: Base Permission is required and SYSTEM_ADMIN membership never creates a runtime authorization bypass.
Auto Numbering state belongs in auto_numbering_series and auto_numbering_counters, not resources.
Number allocation and business create share one transaction and serialization boundary; rolled-back numbers may be reused.
P1 has one Product entity with derived SIMPLE, PARENT, CHILD, and COMBO roles; PARENT is not transactionable.
Nested COMBO composition is allowed only when acyclic and flattened to SIMPLE/CHILD leaves.
Pricing resolves Product + UOM + Company + effective time, falling back Company list, Group list, then correct-UOM default.
The P1 import target is Product only, with CREATE_ONLY, UPDATE_ONLY, and UPSERT modes.
Import requires product.import and each row still requires normal product mutation authorization.
A failed import row leaves no partial business mutation or Auto Number allocation.
workflow_states.code is the canonical workflow identity; name is display data and bootstrap name equals code.
Public APIs use /api/v1, snake_case JSON, string BIGINT/DECIMAL values, stable machine errors, and locale headers.

Backend human-readable localization uses CodeIgniter Language. Domain/service errors use stable machine codes and are locale-independent. API presentation resolves vi/en messages and Content-Language. Frontend application-controlled text uses vue-i18n.

§4.8 Canonical error code convention; §4.9 Language negotiation / localized messages

rules.text: Vue UI stores canonical keys, uses vi/en vue-i18n with vi fallback, and does not translate business identifiers or enum codes.
Protected entrypoints flow through an application use case, trusted context, authorization, domain service, and repository; adapters do not bypass the boundary.
One operation captures EvaluationTime once, uses a trusted actor or explicit system actor, and stamps UTC audit fields outside caller payload ownership.
Repository query failure is distinct from a successful query with no row or empty collection and must retain a typed persistence identity.
Domain lock timeout/deadlock preserves CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION, uses one session, finite configuration, and never masks an earlier domain exception during release.
Positive technical IDs use one canonical parser/normalizer; is_numeric() is not an accepted ID validator.
Product Group uses nullable parent_id adjacency-list at arbitrary depth; hierarchy mutations reject self-parent/cycles, preserve global code uniqueness, and require product-group-tree serialization.

Import row results preserve original row_number; job counts are derived from persisted SUCCESS/ERROR/SKIPPED rows under import_jobs FOR UPDATE, and generated Product code is the successful row entity_key.

rules.text: Implement only CONTRACT_READY public surfaces; CONTRACT_PENDING or source-open fields/actions remain blocked/out-of-scope and must not be guessed.
Every public API contract change updates repository OpenAPI in the same task, passes Redocly lint, regenerates typed frontend artifacts, and never hand-edits generated output.
List/query fields are allowlisted, authorization/data scope is applied before total/count, and deterministic ordering uses the canonical tie-breaker.

COMBO allocation resolves each root price once, ignores nested COMBO price, weights leaves by quantity times Base-UOM products.price, rejects nonpositive total weight, and conserves rounded root amount with deterministic residual/aggregation.

resources.domain is required security metadata with canonical values SYSTEM, MASTER, ORGANIZATION; canonical existing Resource domain is immutable in normal P1 runtime. SYSTEM/MASTER -> GROUP; ORGANIZATION -> registered authoritative resolver; no COMPANY domain.

provenance.section: §11.1 resources and §11.1.1 Canonical Resource Domain semantics

rules.text: P1-API-020 Slice 2 covers Department, Position, Employee, and Employee Assignment. Department/Position/Employee are MASTER at GROUP; Assignment is ORGANIZATION: create uses request organization_id, existing target uses persisted organization_id, list authorizes each persisted row before total/pagination. Employee Organization/Department/Position filters are data filters only. Employee gender uses the DEC-P1-001 nullable canonical catalog MALE, FEMALE, OTHER, or NULL; exact export media type remains CONTRACT_PENDING.

Employee Assignment create/changed references must satisfy active-selection rules and Primary effective periods must not overlap; historical Assignments remain readable after end/inactivation. Do not make a historical end/inactivate fail solely because an already-referenced Organization/Department/Position later became inactive.

Display Settings are presentation-only. They must not become authority for authorization, workflow, pricing, effective dates, Auto Numbering, Import behavior, canonical persistence, authoritative decimal calculation, or business timezone.

Server Display Settings support only system and organization:<id> contexts; effective resolution is current Organization, exact ancestors, GROUP, SYSTEM, then registry default, without trusting client ancestry or Primary Assignment fallback.

Display Settings administrative definitions and overrides use Resource display_setting in ORGANIZATION domain with view/edit actions through canonical AuthorizationService/PBAC; runtime snapshots require authentication and safe Organization visibility but not administrative view.
